inboxes.name: nfl-packets-inbox
inboxes.note: NFL's own packet inbox. Packets carrying payload/nfl.ingest.json are attributed to their producer.

inboxes.name: nfl-raw-files
inboxes.note: Operator drop folder: every file's SHA-256 is committed.

inboxes.name: nfl-integration-receipts
inboxes.note: constellation.integration.receipt.v1 lines (*.ndjson) dropped by emitters; each line is checked against the registered integrations.

inboxes.name: neverlost-outbox
inboxes.note: NFL is the consumer here: it writes an nfl>neverlost integration receipt per packet read.
